protocol_reference: OMR-03 Dataset & Ground Truth Protocol Proposal (session analysis, prior to this execution)
source_of_cases: tests/fixtures/normalize/llm/ambiguous_signals.json — the ONLY versioned, real repository fixtures for Normalization classification available at the time of construction. No new evidence or signal was authored or invented for this dataset.
size_assessment: PRELIMINARY / BELOW THE MINIMUM PROPOSED SIZE. The prior sizing analysis proposed a minimum of ~40 cases per ambiguous field for the pre-registered thresholds to be discretely interpretable. This dataset has 4 cases producing 5 field-level evaluation points total (market x2, language x1, signal_type x1, durability_hint x1-indeterminate). This is far below that minimum and is not sufficient, by itself, to accept or reject the OMR-03 Threshold Policy V1 with statistical confidence. See REPORT.md sections 'Limitations' and 'Threshold Evaluation'.
note_on_durability_hint_n: durability_hint has 1 ambiguous-field instance in the dataset, but its ground truth is INDETERMINATE, so per the pre-registered OMR-03 policy (item 6, indeterminate cases excluded from the accuracy denominator) it contributes 0 evaluable data points to the durability_hint accuracy metric. Only the abstention-appropriateness measurement applies to it.
explicitly_not_covered: no multi-field case with 3+ ambiguous fields simultaneously
no case exercising 11 of the 12 signal_type taxonomy values
no case with evidence in Portuguese where language itself (not signal_type) is the ambiguous field
no source_type over-represented or under-represented deliberately — each of the 4 source_types appears exactly once, by coincidence of the inherited fixtures, not by designed stratification
